targets.expected_type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (hw : net.Nonnegative) (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (φ : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ × ℝ) (hv : ValidPairActivation σ φ) (hm : Monotone φ) (hc : ConvexPairActivation φ), Monotone (net.decomposeWith φ) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun x : PairVec n => (net.decomposeWith φ x).1 i)) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun x : PairVec n => (net.decomposeWith φ x).2 i)) ∧ ∀ x : PairVec n, (net.decomposeWith φ x).1 - (net.decomposeWith φ x).2 = net.forwardWith σ (x.1 - x.2)
targets.scope: Actual complete decomposeWith network: global coordinatewise monotonicity, joint coordinatewise convexity on PairVec, and exact forwardWith recovery. Only split weights are nonnegative; biases and input streams may be signed. No smoothness or input nonnegativity hypothesis.

targets.expected_type: ∀ {d n m : ℕ} (net : Network n m) (hw : net.Nonnegative) (φ : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ × ℝ) (hm : Monotone φ) (hc : ConvexPairActivation φ) (p q : Vec d → Vec n) (hp : ∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun x => p x i)) (hq : ∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun x => q x i)), (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun x => (net.decomposeWith φ (p x,q x)).1 i)) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (fun x => (net.decomposeWith φ (p x,q x)).2 i))
targets.scope: Arbitrary coordinatewise convex input streams into the actual complete split network. No affine-only input restriction; no assertion that a signed input lift is monotone in the original input.

targets.scope: Scalar monotone jointly convex maps of two input streams preserve convexity under coordinatewise convex stream substitution; this applies to actual signed affine readout heads.
